fusions.name: Out of the Rafters
fusions.desc: Swoops you to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 14 dark damage and leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow Fang Dart
fusions.desc: Throws a hollow dart that deals 4 dark damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Soundings
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Quick Draught
fusions.desc: Each critical hit you land makes your attacks heal you for 25% of the damage they deal for 6 seconds. Once every 18 seconds.
